[Trend Position]
· Current price ($347.06) above SMA5 ($345.07), below SMA20 ($350.14) and SMA50 ($351.32) — indicating a short-term trend shift to weaker, with mid-term trend facing downward pressure.
· Below SMA100 ($356.69), above SMA200 ($333.44) — suggesting a weaker bias in the long-term trend.
· 52-week position (69.7%) + current price level is approximately 15% below the 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 46.2 → 48.8 (staying neutral) — exiting oversold territory and consolidating in the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram -0.5583 → -0.0342 (improving) — weakening bearish reversal signal, potential for bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price ($347.06) below the middle band ($350.14) — confirming resistance near the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($346.36) — based on SMA5 and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($349.00) — based on Bollinger Band middle band and 5-day high.
· 5-day low ($338.57) > 20-day low ($330.34) * 1.005 → Higher Low → recovery signal.
